entries.label: Health Canada
entries.title: Qualifying notice for Hernexeos (304237)
entries.description: A Notice of Compliance with Conditions (NOC/c) is authorization to market a drug (i.e. a Notice of Compliance (NOC)), with the condition that the Sponsor undertake additional studies to verify the clinical benefit. Health Canada issues the NOC under section C.08.004 of the Food and Drug Regulations for a submission that qualifies under the Guidance Document: Notice of Compliance with Conditions (NOC/c).
entries.summary: Health Canada granted a Notice of Compliance with Conditions for Hernexeos, requiring additional studies to confirm clinical benefit.
entries.why_it_matters: The RA team must monitor the sponsor’s compliance with the study requirements to ensure continued market authorization.

entries.label: Health Canada
entries.title: Guide to reporting and providing information on drug shortages and discontinuations (GUI-0120)

entries.summary: The guide introduces updated procedures for reporting drug shortages and discontinuations to regulatory authorities.
entries.why_it_matters: Market authorization holders must now comply with new reporting requirements under sections C.01.014.8 to C.01.014.91, ensuring timely disclosure of shortages or discontinuations.

entries.label: Health Canada
entries.title: Guide to distributing drugs intended for the Canadian market for consumption or use outside Canada (GUI-0145)
entries.description: This document is intended to help drug establishment licence holders comply with sections C.01.014.94 to C.01.014.95 of the Food and Drug Regulations.
entries.summary: The guide provides instructions for drug establishment licence holders on how to comply with sections C.01.014.94 to C.01.014.95 regarding the distribution of drugs intended for the Canadian market that will be consumed or used outside Canada.
entries.why_it_matters: RA teams must ensure their distribution processes meet these regulatory sections, affecting all licence holders planning to ship Canadian‑market drugs abroad.

entries.label: Health Canada
entries.title: Guide on the exceptional importation and sale of drugs in response to shortages and discontinuations (GUI-0148)
entries.description: This document will help drug establishment licence holders comply with sections C.10.004 to C.10.013 of the Food and Drug Regulations.
entries.summary: This document provides guidance for drug establishment licence holders on how to handle exceptional importation and sale of drugs during shortages or discontinuations.
entries.why_it_matters: RA teams must use this guide to comply with sections C.10.004 to C.10.013 of the Food and Drug Regulations when managing drug shortages or discontinuations.

entries.label: Health Canada
entries.title: Guide on extending expiration dates of marketed drugs in response to drug shortages (GUI-0500)

entries.summary: A guidance document to help holders extend expiration dates of marketed drugs to address shortages.
entries.why_it_matters: Regulatory teams must review and apply the new guidance to adjust product shelf‑life as per sections C.010.014 to C.10.021, ensuring continued availability and compliance.
